conservatoire.name: Le hall du conservatoire · The conservatory hall
conservatoire.alt: The round entrance hall of the conservatory on open day, seen from high up at an angle under a frosted glass dome, with a frieze of music notes, potted palms and ivy garlands. At the back, by the tall record shelves, a red-haired technician on a stepladder fixes a mirrored disco ball, a boy in sunglasses dances holding up a giant paper clip while a phone on a tripod films him, a lady dressed as a Greek muse sings one long note and a bearded busker plays a little concertina. Beside the big inlaid golden lyre in the middle of the floor, a pop idol in a silver jacket signs a floppy rag doll held up by a delighted little fan. At the front a girl in yellow turns the handle of a music box while her grey kitten mews and a white mouse squeaks, an old sailor and his son sing a shanty on a crate, Monsieur Verbe in a red beret whistles at a tall souffle, and a man in a cardigan listens to a record spinning on his record player. The dark oak doors at the near end of the left wall lead out to the boulevard, the cream lyre doors further along the left wall open into the orchestra hall, the honey-wood door with piano keys in the back wall leads to the piano class, and the blue door up a few steps at the far right goes down to the studio.

orchestre.name: La salle d'orchestre · The orchestra hall
orchestre.alt: The orchestra rehearsal hall seen at an angle, honey-wood walls meeting in a corner at the back. In the middle the conductor stands on a round wooden podium, turned to the players and beating time with his baton. Beside a golden harp at the back a lady with a silver bun plays the cello with her eyes closed, a blond girl plays a silver flute so hard her blank sheet flies off the stand, and Monsieur Verbe in his red beret strikes a triangle with a blue jay perched on it. At the back right a big plush orca sits on a wooden chest and a wild-haired composer scribbles with a quill, sitting on a green compost bin. In the foreground a woman in a red jacket blows a brass trumpet while her puppy covers its ears, and a little girl in a red marching jacket marches pulling a toy car bouncing on springs. On the right a man carries in a stack of black instrument cases and a scowling man in a tan coat bangs a big red drum. The cream lyre doors on the left wall lead back to the hall and the pale-blue door with a wreath at the back right opens into the choir room.

chorale.name: La salle de chant · The choir room
chorale.alt: The choir room of the conservatory seen from high up at an angle from the near-left corner: pale-blue walls, choir robes hanging on a row of pegs under painted music notes, an upright piano, potted plants, and a long platform of light oak risers along the back wall in front of a big painted coral-reef mural full of fish. Up on the risers four children in blue robes sing together, Monsieur Verbe sings with a bale of hay held over his head, and a grey-bearded choirmaster wrapped in a tartan shawl sings a slow chant with his hands together. Just below the risers a girl in an orange jumper blows a big pink bubble of gum on a little staircase of coloured blocks. On the floor nearest the door a diva in a red gown and pink boa poses in a snorkel mask and yellow flippers, and on a round blue rug an opera singer in purple sings with her arms wide between two potted trees. On the right a round man in a polka-dot waistcoat and a big frilly ruff collar sings waving an open lace fan, and a singer in a gold sequined jacket belts out a song beside a big globe. The pale-blue door with a wreath in the near left wall leads back to the orchestra hall.

studio.name: Le studio de répétition · The band rehearsal studio
studio.alt: The basement band studio of the conservatory seen from high up at an angle from the near-left, under red brick vaults, with grey foam panels on the back wall, a red lamp over the door and a long wooden stage with a drum kit and amplifiers along the back right. Up on the stage a white-haired granny in a studded leather jacket and headphones head-bangs with both fists up sitting on a big grey boulder, a man in sunglasses and a pork-pie hat plays a golden saxophone, and a samba dancer in a green-and-yellow frilled dress dances with two maracas under a big sun painted on the wall. In the middle of the room Monsieur Verbe shakes all over, wobbly lines around him, on top of a black loudspeaker while a little grey donkey brays beside it. In front, a young woman kneels stuck in a black puddle of tar playing a red electric guitar, a long-haired guitarist with a giant wristwatch sits cross-legged on the red rug with his acoustic guitar, a boy in a green T-shirt drums with wooden spoons on a stack of paper reams, and a cowboy plays the harmonica sitting on a saddle on a wooden crate. A cactus wearing tiny headphones stands in a pot at the near left. The dark-blue door at the top of the steps on the left leads back to the conservatory hall.

doors.label: Le hall
doors.hint: the dark-blue door at the top of the steps under the red light, back to the conservatory hall

piano.name: La classe de piano · The piano room
piano.alt: The piano classroom of the conservatory seen from high up at an angle from the near-left: pale-green walls lined with tall shelves of music books, herringbone honey parquet, and a two-step honey-wood stage along the back. At the back Monsieur Verbe sits at a little round table drumming his fingers beside an empty teacup. Up on the stage a small boy with a bowl haircut plays the violin balancing a blue-and-white china dish on his head, a grey-haired businessman in a suit with a badge on a lanyard plucks a tall double bass, and a young rapper in a cap and hoodie puts one more book on top of a tall tower of song books. On the parquet in front, nearest the door, a lady kneels striking a bronze gong, her hair standing straight up from the deep sound; beside her a pianist in a lilac dress plays an upright piano with a little nest of eggs on top; in the middle a tortoise taps its foot beside a big wooden metronome on a stool; and at the front right a toddler in a yellow romper bangs the keys of a big black grand piano while an old teacher in round glasses clutches his cheeks. A plant pot shaped like a bass clef stands by the tea table. The honey-wood door with a round window, under a painted piano keyboard in the left wall at the near end, leads back to the conservatory hall.

doors.label: Le hall
doors.hint: the honey-wood door under the piano-keys border, back to the conservatory hall
